_help: 'all': true includes every economy the World Bank lists (regional aggregates excluded); a country is shown once it has data for at least 'minIndicators' indicators. Entries under 'countries' are always shown and can add manual values: 'gw' (Gleditsch-Ward code, only needed for the optional UCDP conflict source), 'aliases' (other spellings), 'm49'. Names and UN M49 codes otherwise come from config/country_codes.json and the World Bank.
